test_stimuli.derivation: SECTION B3 semantic_kind=physical_scaled;  bytes 0x19 0x00 decode to raw=((((0x19 << 8) | 0x00) >> 4) & 0xFFF) = 400; public value in milli_degC is (400 * 125) // 2 = 25000.

test_stimuli.name: mechanical_single_channel_negative
test_stimuli.derivation: SECTION B3 semantic_kind=physical_scaled; negative two's-complement  bytes 0xE7 0x00 decode to raw=(((((0xE7 << 8) | 0x00) >> 4) & 0xFFF) - 4096) = -400; public value in milli_degC is (-400 * 125) // 2 = -25000.
